reviewedScenes.mechanism: Eight stable request identities establish the moderate-ambiguity exception while withholding the first split.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The opening holds the same plot through three beats. Its question is concrete, but a brief proposed-cut comparison could make the second beat less static.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A staircase grows on the same feature plane; paired original/squared rulers show how midpoint interpolation changes an unseen route.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: No material geometry defect observed. The second-beat midpoint result appears together with its premise; revealing the probe route after computing each midpoint would improve direction.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: An 8×8 ordered-pair matrix counts actual disagreements, then grows Gini and entropy curves over the same proportion axis.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The 32/64 result is earned by the matrix. Entropy adds a distinct scale and color without replacing the Gini construction.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Twenty-four labeled discs form two actual candidate partitions; computed Gini/entropy gains reveal their different winners. A separate regression mean splits into child means.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The new 24-row and regression premises are explicitly separated from the original eight labels. No observed count, formula or layout conflict.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Additional cuts isolate R3; two later labeled cases enter the fixed regions and expose an extra review and a miss.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Tiny-leaf support and held-out failures retain their identities. Small nearby point labels deserve care in future revisions, but no material overlap was observed in the registered sheet.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Three bootstrap ledgers accumulate repeated row IDs; fitted one-feature stumps preserve those labels and produce R3 scores0/1/0 before the arithmetic mean.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Native sample0105 clearly distinguishes repeated ownership from distinct rows. The mean is earned from actual member outputs.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Three separate continuous targets create residual segments; a residual-fitted stump changes the original prediction and later rounds recompute corrections.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The handling-time objective is explicitly introduced as a different fixture. The current residual plot and old prediction remain meaningfully related throughout.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The original eight binary labels become residuals and curvatures, then two leaf Newton sums update logits and sigmoid probabilities.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The registered sheet shows the original label sums, −1.5/1.25 and 1.5/.75, followed by η = 0.1 logits and sigmoid probabilities. No formula or layout defect observed in those encoded states.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Same-cost model bars lead to actual validation-row error costs; a feature-column permutation preserves labels while costs change240→516.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The same held-out IDs and prices make the shuffle consequence inspectable. The initial bars are a brief comparison, not the entire explanation.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A fixed experiment contrasts training impurity importance with held-out permutation loss; a baseline.50 is reduced by an evolving ambiguity contribution−.30 to score.20.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The first two bar states hold their final supplied statistics for a full beat each. The local contribution construction does causal work; progressive statistic reveal would improve the first half.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: M1 missing and M2 zero retain separate routes; densification changes only M1. Three fitted predictions support the stated bias²/variance/noise illustration.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The missingness intervention is concrete. The final decomposition appears fully formed rather than accumulating its terms, which limits its visual teaching depth.
